about: Work clothes by trade. Staff and managers are drawn with the uniform of their company's trade: the portrait stays, and a transparent clothing layer uniform.<id>.png (512x512, shoulders and collar in the lower 40 percent, nothing above) is drawn over the bottom of it. trades maps a trade id to a uniform id; families is the fallback by trade family; a trade or family that maps to nothing keeps its own clothes. officeRoles keep their own clothes in every trade.
